notes.title: Update 1.2.4 - Leaderboard, Steam Cloud & minor improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've got a fresh update for Umigame with new features, gameplay tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements. Thanks so much to all of you playing and providing feedback—it’s been super valuable as we keep building and refining the game.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Leaderboard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45025035/a3db1f1648c57b2d5861205c2bf482425b74fc70.png[/img]
You can now track and compare the best times to defeat Maeve! Think you're the fastest? Prove it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45025035/75cc1ee17321874f1e0feb1acedb84eb982ff7be.png[/img]
A brand new combat room has been added to the first environment to mix up early runs. (7 more rooms coming soon!)

Your progress is now automatically backed up via Steam Cloud. Start playing on one device and pick up right where you left off on another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45025035/1942c02137715f4d768adb971c266a9912f4980d.png[/img]

Now features AOE attacks to keep you on your toes.

The speed of these AOE attacks now scales with your selected difficulty, giving experienced players a proper challenge.

Control binds for Pass Omnicore to Ally and Use Omnicore Energy have been swapped to feel more intuitive.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[h2]SHIFT Key Icon[/h2]
Previously shown as an up arrow, which confused many players. This has now been corrected for clarity.

Thanks again to everyone testing and sharing feedback—it’s helped us track down bugs and spot areas for improvement.

We’ve noticed some players are struggling with the first boss. To help with that learning curve, we're working on introducing key boss mechanics earlier in the run so players can better prepare before the big fight.
